title: A generic set
hints: A map with empty-struct values, map[T]struct{}, is the usual way to store a set. Map keys must be comparable, which is why the type parameter is [T comparable].
The zero Set has a nil map, and writing to a nil map panics. Add must create the map the first time. Has and Len work fine on a nil map.
func (s *Set[T]) Add(v T) { if s.m == nil { s.m = map[T]struct{}{} }; s.m[v] = struct{}{} }; Has: _, ok := s.m[v]; Len: len(s.m). Union: add every element of both into a new Set.
